title: Patch Notes 1.21.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.21.0

Raiders!

Patch 1.21.0 is now rolling out across all platforms. Restart your game so it can download.

* A new Raider Tool has been added.

* A new Backpack set has been added.

* A crash that sometimes happened when using DirectX 11 has been fixed.

* An issue that let players become trapped inside the Harvester or between destroyed ARC parts has been fixed.

* An exploit that let players walk through walls while picking up a Fuel Cell or Field Crate has been fixed.

Work continues on preparing the Flashpoint update, which is set to arrive next week, bringing new content to explore.

Some players have asked why the weekly patches are relatively small. These weekly updates are meant to deliver smaller quality-of-life fixes and refresh the store rotation. Bigger, content-heavy updates are planned to arrive at the end of each month.

See you topside,

Ossen
